title: 03. Agents from Scratch: Execution & Response Loop
summary: Execution & Response Loop: explanations and runnable examples.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```
YOUR APPLICATION CODE:

1. Receive LLM response with tool_calls
2. Parse tool_calls
3. Execute each tool
4. Build tool result messages
5. Send EVERYTHING back to LLM
6. LLM generates final answer

Message History grows like this:

[
  {"role": "user", "content": "What's weather in Paris?"},
  
  {"role": "assistant", "tool_calls": [{
    "id": "call_abc",
    "function": {"name": "get_weather", 
                 "arguments": '{"city": "Paris"}'}
  }]},
  
  {"role": "tool",              ← Tool result
   "tool_call_id": "call_abc",
   "content": "Paris: 15°C, Cloudy"},
  
  {"role": "assistant",         ← Final answer
   "content": "The weather in Paris is currently 15°C and cloudy. 🌥️"}
]
```
